description: This file defines utilities for executing asynchronous functions with retry policies, including exponential and fixed backoff strategies, as well as retry logic with timeout handling.

classes.name: IBackoffProvider
classes.description: Interface for backoff strategies that determine delay durations between retries.

classes.name: FixedBackoff
classes.description: Implements a backoff strategy with a fixed delay.

classes.name: ExponentialBackoff
classes.description: Implements an exponential backoff strategy with configurable min, max delays and step.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous action with retries and optional backoff, timeout, and cancellation.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries<T>
methods.description: Generic version executing a function returning Task<T> with retry policies.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetriesHelper<T>
methods.description: Internal helper implementing the retry logic with detailed control over retries, timing, and backoff.
